messages:
olga (People Ops): Quick Q&A and cleanup note before calibration packets go out. Two small asks: (1) if a manager uploaded an old version of the review form, please re-upload with the suffix _final and mark "replaced" in the tracker; (2) attach evidence files to the secure uploader, not Slack.

leah (Eng Manager): cc: I accidentally uploaded draft_feedback.pdf earlier. If I replace it, will the timestamp change and affect audit?

olga (People Ops): Replacing will update the "file_updated_at" but we keep an audit row linking old->new. Just put the string "replaced: draft_feedback.pdf -> draft_feedback_final.pdf" in the "notes" column.

matt (HRBP): For calibration chairs: please ignore minor filename tweaks unless manager also changed ratings. We only escalate when evidence or ratings differ.

forms-bot: Incoming: leah@redwood submitted 1 form (auto)

harry (Recruiting Ops): Heads-up: flag any rows that could change comp or offer timelines with "offer_impact"=true. Recruiting will then freeze offers for those rows until calibration finalization.

leah (Eng Manager): One edge case: a report had two peer comments submitted after the manager signed off. Do we accept them?

olga (People Ops): Accept if peer comments arrived before consolidation deadline AND manager confirms they read them (manager add note "peer_comments_reviewed"). If peer comments arrive after consolidation, we log them but they don't change the packet unless chair approves an out-of-cycle adj.

matt (HRBP): Escalation: if a manager cannot confirm within 24h of a late peer comment, HRBP will step in to validate whether it should be considered.

olga (People Ops): For transparency here's the quick validator we run for the next import (share-only):
```
python scripts/validate_reviews.py --cycle=Q2-2026 --check attachments,duplicates,timestamps
```

leah (Eng Manager): Thanks  I will re-upload the final PDF and add the replaced note.

harry (Recruiting Ops): Also ask managers to flag any candidate rows tied to active offers with a short note in the tracker. That speeds triage.

olga (People Ops): Final ops note: import will run at 10:30am PT. If you need manual intervention after import, open a ticket to people-ops@redwood and include row id. We'll post a short import summary in this thread when done. :white_check_mark:
